content: Bepaŋdi mapme Dewit tubulodaguk doktiŋa Bepaŋ wou nintilolak
Yahwe, me mapme adi du saŋiniŋ milaŋ doktiŋa nadifo tilak. Adi du tubulodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋelak wendoktiŋa nadifo gibitaŋ tilak.
Adi weleŋdi maŋgoŋdok nadiguk u agaŋ miŋguŋ. Du unduŋ tiŋa yeguŋ e’, yonadiŋiŋ nadilakata tiŋa mu wabiguŋ.
Tiŋa du adi’walaŋkade buŋa kahaŋ momooŋ hinek timiŋguŋ. Unduŋ timiŋa mapme kuluŋ golnit u mokomiŋguŋ.
Tiŋa hatihati mimiŋdok ganinadiune miŋguŋ. Kaŋ du hatihatiŋiŋ tomboyoulimimbune nai wahaniŋ tuguk.
Du tubulodaguŋ kaŋ wougigitnit tilak. Eŋ wou loloŋnit tiŋa saŋiniŋ u dagoŋ miŋguŋ.
Eŋ kahaŋgedi adigut haliwooŋ halaak. Tiŋa du adigut hatiŋa weleŋ gineŋ nadifo tubumintaguŋ.
Yahwe, Wapum Loloŋnit hinek, me mapmedi du nadisukilitigamulak. Du adi welegedi hinek me mapme kahilelaŋ, wendoktiŋa adi fafaŋe tiŋa yalaak.
Du adi memikgeye hogohogok wanaŋ yohonefafaŋewaaŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa me nediyeŋ adi gabukwihita tiiŋ u yanagila yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ yapmewaaŋ.
Du dagoŋ miŋgilaŋgoŋ mintadakaleeŋ kudup fafaŋeniŋdi yehidaliwelak unduŋ yehidaliwewaaŋ. Biyagoŋ hinek, Yahwe’walaŋ kwihitaŋiŋdi yehitubukadakaaŋ kudup dabugoŋ yehidadapmawaak.
Du wapmihihiye hogohogok wanakaŋ widihikumundapmaŋ tibaaŋ. Kaŋ wapmihihiye-kabe kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ hogok nemu hatineeŋ.
Adi kadakaniŋ tigamdok yonadi tiŋa mede yohebet tineeŋ iŋgoŋ yohebethikdi folooŋ mokit tibaak.
Du tebe kandamdi didimeniŋgoŋ yemhihiŋe tubune kasukuleeŋ udaneeŋ momoneeŋ.
Yahwe, du saŋiniŋge uŋgoniŋ hinek wendok nadiŋa ganintiloyam! Tiŋa undugoŋ du titiŋgedi uŋgoniŋ hinek doktiŋa kap toŋa ganintiloyam.
